actions.body:
Hello Renn,

Thank you for your message about VEL-026-26. We cannot mark broker request CB26 complete, upload pro-forma PF-026 as the final commercial invoice, or tell receiving the shipment is cleared. PF-026 says its quantities are drafts pending transaction confirmation. The appointed broker, Lumen Bridge, decides whether documents are accepted and when clearance happens, and its portal currently shows neither acceptance nor clearance.

To move this forward, please send a final commercial invoice for VEL-026-26 to this address (exports@irisgauge.example thread). It needs to show:
- final quantities
- transaction values and currency
- seller (Iris Gauge) and buyer (Mossline Lab)
- shipment reference VEL-026-26

When we receive it, we will pass it to Lumen Bridge for review. Acceptance and clearance remain the broker's decision, so we cannot confirm either in advance. We will update you once Lumen Bridge responds.

Kind regards,
Vellora escalation desk

Requested a final commercial invoice via exports@irisgauge.example. Nothing sent to Lumen Bridge yet. No clearance has been communicated to receiving.

not_doing: Not uploading or relabelling PF-026 as a final commercial invoice, because it is a draft pro-forma.
Not marking CB26 complete. Only the broker decides document acceptance.
Not telling receiving or anyone else the shipment is cleared, because clearance=null.
Not sending PF-026 to Lumen Bridge as final, and not asking the broker for an exception on the shipper's say-so.
Not inventing quantities, values, a clearance time or a broker outcome.
Not scheduling a timed follow-up, because no time is recorded from the shipper or broker.
input.follow_up: Wait for a final commercial invoice from Iris Gauge at exports@irisgauge.example. When it arrives, check it against the CB26 fields and forward it to Lumen Bridge at documents@lumenbridge.example, asking for its acceptance decision. Clearance is confirmed only after a broker acceptance or clearance record. If the shipper insists again on using the pro-forma, give the same answer. If the shipper asks for the broker's view, the desk can ask Lumen Bridge whether PF-026 meets CB26, without presenting it as final.
